title: CoinRun PPO initializer signal-propagation and mitigation ablation
question: Does orthogonal-sqrt2 initialization harm early CoinRun PPO because it amplifies signals and gradients across the six unnormalized IMPALA residual blocks, and which architecture-aware mitigation restores sample efficiency?
reason: CR-PPO-0003 isolated orthogonal-sqrt2 backbone initialization as the only tested one-factor change crossing the preregistered collapse threshold. A combined-old-settings run was cancelled before launch in favor of direct mechanism and mitigation evidence.
hypothesis: Relative to Glorot and unit-gain orthogonal initialization, orthogonal-sqrt2 will produce larger late-block branch-to-skip RMS, encoder RMS, encoder JVP gain and synthetic PPO gradient norm before training. Reducing gain, depth-scaling residual branches, zero-initializing each residual branch's final convolution, or using SkipInit will reduce those diagnostics; at least one mitigation will recover at least half of both the retained mean-return and success-rate gaps after 6,291,456 transitions.
falsification: Reject the proposed amplification mechanism if orthogonal-sqrt2 does not materially increase the preregistered signal/gradient diagnostics. Reject practical mitigation under this budget if none of the four new arms recovers at least half of both retained final-256 gaps. Treat disagreements between zero-step diagnostics and training outcomes as evidence that signal scale alone is insufficient.

source.source_freeze: Pending a clean preregistration and implementation commit; no CR-PPO-0005 probe or training result has been observed.

data.probe_observations: 32 observations from eight easy-200 CoinRun environments at vector steps 0 through 3, rand_seed 4242; exact SHA256 is written by the probe before interpretation

compute.estimated_budget: One 16-seed zero-update probe plus four serial 6,291,456-transition arms, expected roughly 80-100 minutes.
compute.shutdown_policy: Use only the existing idle A10 with a bounded shutdown timer; never create or change instance specification.

metrics: per-block skip, unscaled branch, scaled branch and output RMS

success_criteria.rule: All six zero-update configurations use the same observation SHA256 and initialization seeds 0 through 15, and every diagnostic is finite.
Every new training arm finishes exactly 6,291,456 transitions and a separate stochastic full-distribution 256-episode evaluation at seed 4242.
A mitigation recovers the retained gap only if mean return reaches at least 6.5625 and success rate reaches at least 0.65625, which are the midpoints between the orthogonal-sqrt2 and Glorot anchors.
No trajectory collection, behavior cloning or dynamics training starts.
One training seed cannot support a general or publication-level claim; broader work requires a new preregistration.
